section: The base / Employment income and sole-trader income
text: Ordinary sole traders calculate actual business income less deductible business costs using the territorial corporate-tax rules and the modifications in IRPF arts 25–27. Include gains and losses on business assets in the business result, with the art 75.3 general-rate adjustment if the general average tax rate exceeds the applicable general corporate rate. Check eligibility/election for simplified direct assessment under the relevant art 26 and regulation before using art 28. Art 28 excludes depreciation, impairment and the specified vehicle/lease expenses from the initial actual-expense computation; the prescribed allowance replaces them. These percentages are not the common-territory 5% expense allowance:

section: The base / General and savings baskets, reductions and pensions
text: Under arts 62–66 classify employment, ordinary business income and other general income separately from savings income. Ordinary residential-property capital income belongs to the territorial savings basket under art 63(a), together with the specified financial-capital returns and disposal gains under art 63(b)–(c). This differs from ordinary common-territory rental-income classification. Calculate the property result using the local art 32 before placing it in that basket. Do not insert the State rental reduction or its actual-cost method into the foral property computation. [Bizkaia NF13/2013, current2026 consolidation](https://www.bizkaia.eus/documents/880307/15187815/ca_13_2013.pdf/ce52e403-4fca-9ef7-bf85-2505ba29f921?t=1784098584068)[Álava NF33/2013, current2026 consolidation](https://web.araba.eus/documents/d/araba/indice_norma-foral_irpf_cas-4-pdf)[Gipuzkoa NF3/2014,2026 consolidation](https://www.gipuzkoa.eus/documents/2456431/8.0759126E7/NF%203-2014%20(2026-0).pdf/8ab5c95c-3f89-8fdf-5cb8-01950e3983cc) arts 30–32,62–66.

section: The base / Housing, care, pension and ordinary spending credits
text: Under Bizkaia 93 bis, Álava 94 bis and Gipuzkoa 92 bis, unused main-home-rent credits carry five years. The specified descendant/purchase credits can also carry five years for under 36 contributors, who must remain under 36 when using that route. Use originating-year conditions/limits and the first year with sufficient quota, before the same current-year credit. Apply any additional named carry rules separately. For 2025–2029, however, the special voluntary-filer main-home-rent rule pays the unused rent credit where the taxpayer is not obliged to file but submits the return and has insufficient quota. Bizkaia uses the provisional assessment; Álava/Gipuzkoa refer to the return or provisional assessment. Offset the paid amount against pending rent credits so it is never refunded and carried twice. This is expressly authorised by BizkaiaDA 44, ÁlavaDA 42 and GipuzkoaDA 43; it is separate from ordinary carryforwards. Business investment, employee-share investment and new-company investment require the separate territorial corporate/credit methods; charitable giving follows the additional table below; the State 50% startup/80% gift figures do not apply automatically. [Bizkaia NF13/2013, current2026 consolidation](https://www.bizkaia.eus/documents/880307/15187815/ca_13_2013.pdf/ce52e403-4fca-9ef7-bf85-2505ba29f921?t=1784098584068)[Álava NF33/2013, current2026 consolidation](https://web.araba.eus/documents/d/araba/indice_norma-foral_irpf_cas-4-pdf)[Gipuzkoa NF3/2014,2026 consolidation](https://www.gipuzkoa.eus/documents/2456431/8.0759126E7/NF%203-2014%20(2026-0).pdf/8ab5c95c-3f89-8fdf-5cb8-01950e3983cc)

section: The base / Navarra benefits credited after the differential quota
text: For advanced home-rent relief under art. 68 quinquies, the advance application is constitutive: a return-only claim without that request creates no right. Use the actual award period's implemented eligibility parameters, not an unchanged amount from the basic law. The precise 2026 Emanzipa change and DAVID household method are listed below as outstanding.

section: The base / Navarra benefits credited after the differential quota
text: Under current statutory 68 quinquies(C), one Emanzipa credit applies per dwelling; divide the 50% rent/max 280 by **all contract holders**, including holders failing individual eligibility, rather than paying 280 each. Savings income must not exceed 5,000, eligible nonbusiness assets/rights 90,000; preserve the statute's qualified other-home/inadequate-home-offer exception and last 5-year disposal proceeds 60,000 threshold rather than shortening them to an unconditional ownership ban. No subletting, no first/seconddegree relative landlord. Emanzipa and DAVID are mutually exclusive and incompatible with 62.2 annual rent credit; an awarded route cannot be renounced for that taxyear. Concession lasts 1 year, renewable, based on rent at application. Evidence every month by bank record identifying landlord, property and month, before the first of the following month; missed months lose entitlement. Overpayments recapture through the relevant differential quota with interest from advance receipt. [Navarra DFL4/2008, current revision20April2026](https://www.boe.es/buscar/act.php?id=BON-n-2008-90013&p=20260420&tn=1)68 quinquies(C)–(E).
